show.description:
Anamika, who works as a waitress in a restaurant, finds out that her uncle and aunt plan to deceive her, so she runs away from the forced wedding. later, she married Jai, who is a stranger to her. why did Anamika and Jai really get married?
Or is there a bigger game behind it?
